description: This file implements a jQuery plugin for a tags input component, allowing users to add, remove, and manage tags within input or select elements with support for features like autocomplete, max tags, and custom styling.

classes.name: TagsInput
classes.description: Constructor function for the tags input plugin, managing tag addition, removal, and UI interactions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new tag item, handling duplicates, max tags, and updating the DOM and underlying select element.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified tag item, updating the DOM and select element.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all tags and resets the component.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the visual representation of tags to match their data items.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns the current array of tag items.

methods.name: pushVal
methods.description: Sets the value of the underlying input or select based on current tags.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes the tags input behavior, event handlers, and options.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes all event handlers and DOM elements associated with the plugin.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the internal input element.

methods.name: findInputWrapper
methods.description: Finds and returns the wrapper element around the input, especially when moved by typeahead.js.
